absorb.label: Absorb the impact
absorb.description: Spend locally to halve every incoming loss.

redirect.label: Redirect the effect
redirect.description: Build an emergency channel and pass the full effect to the next legal town.

embargo.label: Impose an embargo
embargo.description: Take the hit, but block the source town's bank trade and reduce one resource income this decade.

accept.label: Take the hit
accept.description: Accept the full incoming loss without spending resources or retaliating.
